player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Muntu yina vandaka kusala bansaka yango ndimaka na kusoba, kansi yandi kondaka mbongo ya kufwana.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} sosaka kusala mumbongo kukonda kuzwa mbongo ya kufwana.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} pesaka mbongo na yandi ya kusumba sambu bo soba yo, kansi mutindu ya kupesa kele mbote ve.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} pesaka ve mbongo ya nkaka.

offers.accept: Player {acceptor_id} accepted the trade offer from Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} made the following offer to Player {opponent_id}: Offered items: {offered} -> Requested items: {requested}

outcome.win: Muntu yina ke bulaka na {winner_id} me nunga sambu yandi kele ti bima mingi ya ntalu.
outcome.draw: Bima yonso ya bo vandaka na yo kusobaka kaka mutindu mosi.
